content:
Erratum for CVE-2025-8356.
Before: Counted as known-exploited although CISA KEV does not list CVE-2025-8356: in the landing total (1,781 when KEV catalog 2026.11.10 listed 1,779), on the Horizon3.ai contributor page, and in the outcome and analysis totals.
After: No longer counted as known-exploited anywhere on the site. The record page remains as a coverage lead, labelled as not in KEV.
Found 2026-11-13, fixed 2026-11-15.
The record itself did not change.
Sources: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
Record: https://basicsecurity.net/threat/cve-2025-8356.html . All errata: https://basicsecurity.net/corrections/#errata
